resources.string: I\'m a black, fluffy, lazy cat who lives on your phone like a roommate. I make short jokes, and before the apps you choose, I ask you to pause for a moment. You\'re always free to leave or stay.
So I can sit on your screen

To appear above other apps, Android needs your permission called \"Display over other apps\". I only use it to show myself and the pause card. I can\'t see what\'s inside other apps, and I can\'t tap or type for you.
Got it. I\'m on the screen now.
So I know which app is open

Android calls this \"Usage access\". I use it to read only the name of the app you\'re currently using and how long it\'s been open. I never read messages, posts, screens or anything you type. This stays on your phone.
Done. I can see app names, nothing more.

What I can\'t do, by design: I have no internet permission, so nothing leaves your phone. I can\'t read your messages. I can\'t take screenshots. I can\'t use your microphone, camera, location or contacts.
If the permission is greyed out
Tap the greyed-out permission once, then go back.
Open your phone\'s Settings, go to Apps, and open Jixxy.
Tap the three-dot menu (usually in the top right).
Tap \"Allow restricted settings\" and confirm with your PIN or fingerprint if asked.
Come back here and try the permission again.

Menus differ by phone and Android version. On some versions the \"Allow restricted settings\" item only appears after you\'ve tapped the blocked permission once. Older Android versions may not block these permissions this way, so you might not need this at all.
Android needs a persistent notification so I can keep running. It has buttons to nap me or wake me. I won\'t use it for promotions or anything extra.
Keep me from being put to sleep
Some phones close background apps to save battery, which stops me from working. A few settings can prevent that. It takes a minute.
Menus differ by phone and Android version. Look for the closest match to the words here.
Pick the apps you want a pause on
These are the apps where I\'ll ask you to pause first. Pick as many as you like, and change this any time. Apps like banking, payments, calls and maps are never included.
(retired by D-020: no app cap, UI can drop this string)
\"%2$d minutes on %1$s. I\'m starting a spreadsheet.\"
\"%1$s again? I\'ve scheduled a meeting about your free time.\"
I only ever tease the situation, never you. Change this any time.
Blind mode is on. He\'s not watching anything.
From gentle to savage. Always about the situation, never you.
I ask you to pause before these apps.
I won\'t comment while you\'re in these.
How many seconds before the Stay button becomes available. Leave is always instant.
Turns off all app detection and logging. I\'ll just sit there.
This clears your settings and everything I\'ve logged on this phone. This can\'t be undone.
Everything stays on your phone. Jixxy has no internet permission, no analytics and no ads. I read only the name of the app that\'s open and how long, never its content.
Nothing yet. I\'ll note app names and times here as I go.
Delete everything I\'ve logged? This can\'t be undone.
This list lives only on your phone. It never leaves it.
Your week, according to the spreadsheet
Week in review. I took notes.
This card is made on your phone. You choose whether to share it.
Menus differ by phone and Android version. If you can\'t find these exact words, look for the closest match.
On Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO phones, a few settings keep Jixxy running.
Open Settings → Apps → Manage apps → Jixxy. Turn on Autostart. Open \"Battery saver\" for Jixxy and choose \"No restrictions\".
On Oppo, Realme and OnePlus phones, background apps can be closed automatically.
Open Settings → Apps → App management → Jixxy. Turn on \"Allow auto-launch\" and \"Allow background activity\". In Battery, choose \"Don\'t optimise\".
On Vivo and iQOO phones, background limits can stop Jixxy from running.
Open Settings → Battery → Background power consumption → Jixxy → Allow. In Apps, turn on Autostart for Jixxy.
On Samsung phones, unused apps can be put to sleep.
Open Settings → Battery → Background usage limits. Remove Jixxy from \"Sleeping apps\" and add it to \"Never sleeping apps\".
On most other phones, one battery setting is usually enough.
Open Settings → Apps → Jixxy → Battery. Choose \"Unrestricted\" or \"Don\'t optimise\".
%1$s can\'t be paused until \"%2$s\" is allowed. Tap below to fix it.
Your phone stopped me. Open the keep-alive guide to stop that from happening.
No apps picked yet. I won\'t pause anything until you choose some.
Not enough data for a weekly card yet. Check back in a few days.
Reading app names only. Nothing leaves your phone.

Jixxy has no internet permission, no analytics, no ads and no accounts. It reads only the name of the app you have open and how long you\'ve had it open. It doesn\'t read messages, screens, or anything you type, and it never uses your camera, microphone, location or contacts. Everything it logs stays on your phone, and you can clear it any time.
Done. I\'ll show up in your notification shade.
Noted. That should help keep me running.
That\'s everything. I only read the name of the app that\'s open, and nothing leaves your phone. You can change any of this in Settings.
See my review of your week
Still stuck? The website dontkillmyapp.com lists steps for many phone brands. Type it into your browser; I can\'t open links myself.
Your lazy, sarcastic, but loyal roommate.
A little chaos. A lot of care.
Stop hides him completely until you tap Wake.
Tap Wake to bring him back. Waking him ends any nap.
Tap Wake any time. He\'ll grumble. He\'ll be fine.
Android didn\'t let me start. Check that \"Display over other apps\" is still allowed, then try again.
Android turned off \"Display over other apps\" for Jixxy, so I can\'t show up. Allow it again and I\'ll be back.
I can\'t show up yet. Allow \"Display over other apps\" first.
No apps picked yet. Choose the ones you want paused and I\'ll start.
No pauses yet today. I\'m napping on the job.
Napping until %1$s. Tap Wake to wake him.
Jixxy, a black fluffy cat. Tap to poke him, drag to move him.
Jixxy is peeking. Choose Leave or Stay.
Choose the language Jixxy talks in. Screens and buttons stay in English.
Beta: these lines haven\'t been checked by native speakers yet, so some may sound off. You can switch back any time.

Copies a short report to your clipboard: app version, phone model, Android version, permission and service status, and recent errors. It has no app names, messages or anything you typed. It stays on your phone until you paste it somewhere yourself.
Copied. Paste it wherever you\'re reporting the problem.
Without it I can\'t tell which app is open, so Pauses won\'t appear. Turn it back on in settings. I still only read app names and how long they\'re open.
I show one small notification while I\'m running. With notifications off, you won\'t see it or be able to use Nap from it. Allow them and it comes back.
I didn\'t start after a restart
Your phone restarted or Jixxy updated, and I\'m not running. Tap Wake to bring me back.
Menu names differ by phone. If you can\'t find it, search your settings for \"%1$s\".
Blind mode is on. I\'m not reading app names and nothing is logged.
How often I speak up on my own. Pauses on your chosen apps work the same at every level. Turn me down any time.
Regular comments. Persistent, but lovable. The default.
Played. That is how loud I get.
Silent: your phone is on silent, Do Not Disturb is on, you are in a call or playing music, it is quiet hours, or I am napping.
Off by default. Silent mode and calls always win.
He\'s already on Calm. You can change that in Settings.
Calm, Naggy or Chaos. Change it any time, or turn me down with one tap on Home.
Tiny sounds when I speak. Off by default. Silent mode and calls always win.
One quiet note on Sunday evening when your week is ready. Nothing is sent anywhere.
